import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
filtered = df[
    (df['Name'] == 'Deaths due to PM2.5') &
    (df['Geo Place Name'] == 'Kingsbridge - Riverdale') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '2005-2007')
]
result = float(filtered['Data Value'].iloc[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_dohmh_air_quality.csv')
targets = ['Central Harlem - Morningside Heights', 'East Harlem']
filtered = df[
    (df['Name'] == 'Deaths due to PM2.5') &
    (df['Time Period'] == '2005-2007') &
    (df['Geo Place Name'].isin(targets))
]
result = filtered.sort_values(by='Data Value', ascending=False)['Geo Place Name'].iloc[0]
